subject: Shared demo week — east/west tracks and preparatory materials
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara@acuityhealth.com>, John Park <john.park@nimble.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Shared demo week — east/west tracks and preparatory materials

Hi all,

Thanks for agreeing to join a joint demo week. The idea is to run two short tracks (East / West) across a single week so our engineering and product folks can see: (1) Redwood hosting options and latency tradeoffs, (2) Dedicated capacity walkthrough, and (3) a short integration checklist.

Proposed high-level plan (attached):
- Monday: intro + hosted API walkthrough (30m)
- Wednesday: Dedicated capacity deep-dive (45m)
- Friday: Q&A + next steps (30m)

To make this useful for everyone, please tell us your preferred timezone window (US Pacific / US Eastern / EMEA afternoon) and if you want a dedicated 1:1 after the group session. I've attached a draft agenda and a CSV with the initial participant list.

Attachments: agenda-demo-week.pdf, participant-list.csv

Next steps: If you can confirm your primary timezone preference by EOD Tuesday (11/3), we'll lock the calendar and send a single calendar invite with two parallel tracks.

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

---
Note: calendar invite will be a single bundle with separate "East" and "West" tracks so participants can pick the session that fits.
From: Sara Lin <sara@acuityhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Shared demo week — east/west tracks and preparatory materials

Thanks, Laura — this looks great.

AcuityHealth preference: US Eastern afternoons work best for our product and security folks. If you must pick a single slot, aim for 2:00–3:30pm ET (that keeps it before our nightly maintenance window). We would like a 20–30 minute dedicated follow-up to cover our compliance questions (SOC 2 / data residency), so please block one 30m slot the week of the demo.

Also: can you include a short note in the calendar invite that the Dedicated capacity section will show throughput numbers at 256-token averages? Our infra team will want that to triage sample queries.

Best,
Sara
Sara Lin
Lead Product Manager, AcuityHealth
sara@acuityhealth.com

Hi everyone —

Thanks for the quick replies. We've locked in the two-track approach:
- East track — Wednesday, Nov 11, 2:00PM ET (hosted API + Q&A)
- West track — Wednesday, Nov 11, 11:00AM PT (hosted API + Q&A)
- Dedicated deep-dive — Friday, Nov 13, 10:00AM PT (45m)

Attached: agenda-demo-week.pdf (v2) and shared-demo-invite.ics. The invite contains both track options; please accept only the track you plan to attend. I've added a note on the Dedicated section with the 256-token throughput examples per Ben's request.

Marissa, could you please include the recording link and the secure notes for the SOC 2 follow-up in the invite description?

If any conflicts remain, reply with your preferred single slot and we'll handle rescheduling for your org.

Best,
Laura
